text:
maria: Heads-up — proposal to cut a semver bump to v0.15.0 across api / runtime / console / sdks. Need alignment on changelog lines, compatibility notes, and cutoff window. Can each repo confirm readiness?

sam: runtime is green on tests. thinking we should land the perf patch (reduce KV mem) before the bump. needs one more approval.

aj: sdk side: client changes are backwards compatible but we added a new retry header default. will require a short note in the SDK CHANGELOG. PR #482 is ready for review.

tess: console: UX change landed yesterday; we'll need a migration note for saved queries and to bump the console minor. I can cut the console PR once runtime tag is set.

ivan: quick question — do we want a single coordinated tag across repos (v0.15.0) or independent repo bumps? prefer single tag for public docs but ok with independent if it simplifies CI.

maria: prefer single logical release id v0.15.0 so docs + release notes match. process: each repo opens PR with title prefix "release: v0.15.0" and add a one-line changelog entry. cutoff = 24h from now for code changes, 48h for docs.

beth: QA: can we freeze integration tests 6h before cutoff? need time to run cross-repo smoke tests. also request a short canary on staging after tags.

ci-bot: automated checks: runtime CI ✅; api unit tests flaky (2 failing tests) — failing test ids: test-auth-refresh, test-batch-timeout.

sam: I'll rerun the flaky ones now and ping owners.

aj: SDK release note suggestion: "SDK: default retry header added; opt-out via ClientOptions.retryHeader=false" — is that too implementation-y?

maria: that's fine, short and actionable. We'll expand in the full changelog entry.

ivan: tagging process draft:
```
# after all PRs merged to main
git tag -a v0.15.0 -m "release: v0.15.0"
git push origin v0.15.0
# trigger release pipeline (release-bot will pick this up)
```

maria: add checklist for each repo (paste into PR body):
- [ ] PR title: "release: v0.15.0"
- [ ] one-line CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased
- [ ] update compat-matrix if applicable
- [ ] add smoke test to release job

beth: QA will run cross-repo smoke script: `./ci/smoke/e2e-release-check.sh v0.15.0` — please make sure artifacts are available.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window: staging canary 2026-03-20T10:00Z -> 2026-03-20T12:00Z. promote to prod after manual sign-off.

maria: final reminder: if you need more than the 24h cutoff (e.g., hotfixes), ping me directly. also please tag any breaking changes clearly in PR body and mention migration steps.

sam: I pushed a small fix, PR #501. tagging reviewers: @beth @ivan @maria

aj: SDK PR #482 ready for merge on green. ping @sam for cross-check on headers.

tess: console PR #230 queued; will wait for runtime tag before merging the display migration.

ivan: I'll coordinate the single tag once all merges are done. will post here before tagging.

maria: thanks everyone — I'll compile the changelog snippets later today and post the release notes draft here for review. :thumbsup:
